name: Naughty Magic
source:
Starting college in another state can be a problem.  That is unless you have a really good family friend in that town, who can give you a place to stay.  And if that family friend is female, gorgeous, and with two sexy daughters, so much the better!

So here you are, enough male hormones to power a small space-going vessel and living with three beautiful women.   Life is “interesting”.  Now let’s add some magic to the mix, then stir and see what happens.  Will you fulfill your sexual dreams, or will you be thrown out of the house?  Play Naughty Magic and find out.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/naughty-magic-0-15222294]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
在另一个州开始大学可能是一个问题。除非你在那个镇上有一个非常好的家庭朋友，他可以给你一个住宿的地方。如果那个家庭朋友是女性，漂亮，并且有两个性感的女儿，那就更好了！

现在，你拥有足够的雄性激素来为一艘小型太空飞船提供动力，并与三个美丽的女人生活在一起。生活是“有趣的”。现在让我们在混合物中添加一些魔法，然后搅拌，看看会发生什么。你会实现你的性梦想，还是会被赶出家门？玩顽皮魔法并找出答案。
